verdict.rationale: The only deletion capability in the evidence is that lists can be deleted from another system via the API. Nothing covers retention-period settings, contact-level or account-level erasure, or privacy-oriented deletion guarantees, so support is a single thin mention. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies, documented contact/account data erasure (e.g., GDPR deletion requests), deletion guarantees or timelines, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Create, rename, duplicate, merge, and delete lists from another system.
